title: kbmon's sessions panel reads every coord event on each collect, so a slow store times out and every overlap then reads as age 0
goal: the sessions panel asks coord.py wait for the kinds it reads only, and a store it cannot read leaves the overlaps out and says so in the panel

run:
import re, sys
text = open('_tools/mon_sessions.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
m = re.search(r'def read_events.*?(?=\ndef )', text, re.S)
body = m.group(0) if m else ''
print('read_events asks for a kind:', '--kind' in body)
sys.exit(0 if '--kind' in body else 1)

repro_reason: a slow store cannot be planted in a short run; the end state is the call's own arguments
